title: Indian AQI category reference
description: Six published categories, not live city readings.
limitations: No monitor readings, pollutant concentrations or medical recommendations are included.
This table is not an AQI calculator. Do not average pollutant indices or extrapolate a new category outside the published ranges.

definitions.aggregation: Overall index follows the worst qualifying pollutant sub-index, subject to the methodology and data requirements.
